questions.q: "I am tired." (said yesterday) → She said she ___ tired.
questions.why: Коли переказуємо вчорашні слова, час зсуваємо на крок назад: *am* → *was*: *She said she was tired.*

questions.q: "I will call you." (said last week) → He said he ___ me.
questions.why: *will* у непрямій мові → *would*: *He said he would call me.*

questions.q: "I have finished." → She said she ___ (finish).
questions.why: Present Perfect → Past Perfect: *She said she had finished.*

questions.q: "Where do you live?" → He asked me where ___.
questions.why: Непряме питання має прямий порядок слів (без *do*) і зсув часу: *He asked me where I lived.*

questions.q: "Are you ready?" → She asked ___ I was ready.
questions.why: Питання «так / ні» в непрямій мові вводимо через *if* (або *whether*): *She asked if I was ready.*

questions.q: "Close the door." → He told me ___ the door.
questions.why: Наказ → *tell* + особа + *to* + дієслово: *He told me to close the door.*

questions.q: "I'll see you tomorrow." (said last week) → She said she'd see me ___.
questions.why: Слова про час теж зсуваються: *tomorrow* → *the next day*.

questions.q: "Don't be late." → She told us ___.
questions.why: Заперечний наказ → *not to* + дієслово: *She told us not to be late.*

questions.q: "I can swim." → He said he ___ swim.
questions.why: *can* → *could*: *He said he could swim.*

questions.q: She ___ me that she was tired.
questions.why: *tell* вимагає особи після себе: *She told me that…* *said* — без особи (*She said that…*).

questions.q: "I'm working." → She said she ___ working.
questions.why: *am* → *was*: *She said she was working.*

questions.q: "We went to Rome." → They said they ___ to Rome.
questions.why: Past Simple → Past Perfect (*had gone*); у розмові часто лишають без зміни (*went*).

questions.q: "Can you help me?" → She asked me ___ I could help her.
questions.why: Питання «так / ні» → *if / whether*.

questions.q: "Don't touch it." → He told me ___ touch it.
questions.why: Заборона → *not to* + дієслово: *He told me not to touch it.*

questions.q: "I'll be here tomorrow." → He said he would be there the ___ day.
questions.why: *tomorrow* → *the next day / the following day*.

questions.q: "I like jazz." → He ___ that he liked jazz.
questions.why: *say* — без особи: *He said that he liked jazz.* *said me* — помилка (тоді *told me*).

questions.q: "What are you doing?" → She asked me what ___.
questions.why: Непряме питання — прямий порядок: *what I was doing*.

questions.q: "I must go." → She said she ___ go.
questions.why: *must* (обов'язок) → *had to*: *She said she had to go.*

questions.q: "I saw him yesterday." → She said she had seen him ___.
questions.why: У непрямій мові *yesterday* → *the day before*.

answer: She said that she was tired
questions.why: *said (that)* + зсув часу: *am* → *was*.

answer: He told me to wait outside
questions.why: *told* + особа + *to* + дієслово.

answer: She asked me where I lived
questions.why: Непряме питання — прямий порядок слів: *where I lived*.

questions.q: She says she ___ tired. (каже зараз)
questions.why: Якщо головне дієслово в теперішньому (*says*), зсуву часу немає: *She says she is tired.*

questions.q: The teacher said that water ___ at 100°C.
questions.why: Загальна істина може лишатися в Present Simple: *water boils at 100°C*.

questions.q: He asked me where ___.
questions.why: Непряме питання — прямий порядок: *where I lived*.

questions.q: "Let's eat out." → She suggested ___ out.
questions.why: *suggest* + *-ing*: *She suggested eating out.*

questions.q: "Could you help me?" → He asked me ___ help him.
questions.why: Прохання → *ask* + особа + *to* + дієслово: *He asked me to help him.*
